text:
The stars are children in a ring,

playing at spying on the earth…

The wheat stalks are the waists of girls,

playing at swaying…, swaying…


The rivers are children in a ring,

playing at meeting in the sea…

The waves are girls dancing in a ring,

playing at embracing Earth…

translation.title: The Stars Are Children in a Ring…
translation.editorial_note: Ronda is rendered as a children's ring game, preserving both circular motion and play.
